name: page_stack_get

provenance.source: Exact .139 pagemanager decompilation; page lifecycle ladder recovered from the state byte at page+40 and the handler-chain callbacks.

notes: Stack-relative page accessor; index -1 yields the stack-top page. Wraps app_list_get_page over the global page stack at 0x200c33ac. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
